column1: # static_data_copies.tsv - compiler-emitted per-TU copies of header statics
# (the GruntDirStatics device, docs/data-attribution.md): DATA() in a header
# is ignored, so these reviewed rows are folded into symbol_names.csv by
# THE OWNER OF A BLOCK IS ITS STATIC INITIALIZER'S POSITION. Each copy is
# constructed by a `$E` initializer that cl emits at the HEAD of that TU's .text
# contribution, so the first named function AFTER the code that stores into the
# nine cells names the owning unit. That rule reproduces 63 of these 71 blocks
# unaided; it is how the three former `ghidra` holding-unit blocks were homed on
# multistartdlg) and how 0x2496e8 was corrected off netlobbydialogs, which the
# first of those would otherwise have given two copies.
# EVERY row carries an rva-suffixed name (2026-08-09): a PLAIN name is shared
# by all 71 blocks, so the delink data manifest used to withhold it ("duplicate
# name in manifest") and ~57 blocks went entirely uncompared. Suffixed names
# are unique, so every copy now enrolls, and the normalizer rewrites
# delinked copy with the base TU's own emission. A row must therefore never
# name a unit objdiff cannot open (that was the `ghidra` defect) and must not
# be given to a TU whose base obj does not emit the cells - either mistake is
# now VISIBLE as an unpaired symbol in that unit's .bss score.
# Four blocks still disagree with the initializer rule and are the remaining
# split half-copies (E,N,S,W | NE,NW,SE,C,SW around a per-TU interleaver)
# CButeMgr getter-local statics (guards + static return slots), ButeMgr.cpp
# 2026-08-09, lane/unmodelled-data: the 25 blocks the data-access sieve still
# reported as `unclaimed`. Each cell's IDENTITY is read off its own `$E`
# initializer - the (row, column, direction) triple it stores - not off
# position: decoding all 107 initializers in the image gives ADDRESS ORDER ==
# declaration order (East, North, South, West, NE, NW, SE, Center, SW) for
# every block without exception, and the three banks that are separately
# claimed (?g_gruntDir*, ?g_gruntMoveDir*, and the 0x244aa0 extern set) agree
# cell-for-cell. The unit is the initializer rule above.
# Four banks are deliberately NOT here, each with a reason:
#   0x244970  claimed by _g_dirVec, an i32[9][4] in GruntCombat.cpp that models
#             these nine cells as ONE array. Retail never indexes it: all 45
#             reads and 27 writes are `direct` absolute addresses, so the
#             storage is nine separate cells. Blocked on retyping g_dirVec.
#             declared 0x850 extent. g_netCmdSendMsg is at 0x24a058 and retail
#             constructs direction cells at +0x400, so 0x850 over-claims;
# A block whose owner already holds a same-named plain row needs the
# rva-suffixed spelling, which enrolls a target-side symbol our base obj
# spells plainly - 74 such rows already cost 896 B of unpaired .bss. The seven
# 0x24e5c0) are therefore left open; they are TU-partition work, not naming.
